observations: Photo 0 shows a collection of used car parts leaning against a wall.
Visible items include two drive shafts (axle shafts) with rubber boots, a steering rack (steering gear), a radiator (condenser), and a starter motor.
The parts appear to be from a scrapped vehicle.
The environment is a cluttered outdoor or garage setting.

claims.claim: Scrap car metal parts available for sale
Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added. Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The parts may be from a different vehicle model than the one the buyer intends to use.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle identification number (VIN) stamped on the engine block or chassis.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic scrap metal value

risks.risk: The starter motor may be seized or unable to turn.
risks.proof: A video showing the starter motor being cranked or tested with a multimeter.

risks.risk: The radiator may have internal leaks or be blocked.
risks.proof: A photo of the radiator with the top tank removed to check for leaks.

risks.risk: The drive shafts may have internal damage or be out of specification.
risks.proof: A photo of the shafts with the boots removed to inspect the splines.

proof_requests: Photo of the VIN to confirm the vehicle origin.
Video of the starter motor being tested.
Photo of the radiator with the top tank removed.
Photo of the drive shafts with the rubber boots removed.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
